newsitem.title: USA: U.S. donates food for ag modernization in Haiti.
newsitem.headline: U.S. donates food for ag modernization in Haiti.

text.p: The United States will donate 6,630 metric tons (tonnes) of bread flour, soybean oil and pinto beans to Haiti to assist expansion of an agricultural school, the Agriculture Department said Tuesday.

It said the goods would be donated to Salesian Missions, a charity, for sale in Haiti. Proceeds would be used to update and expand an agricultural school, which would provide expert advice to other agriculture schools.

Donation would include 6,000 metric tons of bread flour, 330 tons of soybean oil and 600 of pinto beans. It would be channeled through the Food for Progress program, which encourages free-market development.
